  `"gold-standard-image-flash-high-t0.7-n10-t7-era2"` and `n_tiles:
  487` are unambiguous.

claims.notes: The internal condition label (t0.7, n10, t7, -era2) is a name, out of C4 scope per rule 5; only the asserted 487-tile scope is a claim. Section 2 of this document cites evaluation.json lines 5 and 26; the n_tiles field sits under summary.buffers[*].coverage in that artefact.

After the
  recovery, the canonical Era 2 verifier output has 380 detections.

claims.claim_text:

  tiles

values.quantity: count of hard-example-mining calibration tiles (pool_160) excluded from Era 2 to form Era 3

claims.notes: `pool_160` is a name (rule 5); the asserted 160-tile exclusion is the claim. The document cites results/evaluation-scopes.md:92-104, which is prose, so the anchor is the calibration bounds GeoJSON that defines the footprint (rule 2).

values.quantity: tile count of the Era 2 evaluation pool (minuend of the asserted identity)
count of pool_160 calibration tiles removed (subtrahend of the identity)
tile count of the Era 3 evaluation pool (result of the identity)

claims.notes: Asserted identity: Era 2 (operand a) minus the pool_160 footprint (operand b) equals Era 3, whose own bounds artefact is the anchor file. The minus sign in the source is U+2212, not a hyphen.

claims.claim_text:
not the same area as the original 20-tile calibration that all three
